answer: Challenge-Derived Seat Binding. Each agent occupies a numbered seat in a shared crystal ledger; to act, it must answer a fresh challenge derived from the prior block’s unrepeatable state, and the winning answer is hashed into the vault as the next challenge seed. A clone cannot replay an answer because each seed is consumed once. The reef of historical seeds is public, so duplicates are rejected instantly. Attacker cost: one live computation per seat per round, linear in identities and impossible to amortize.
